prd.title: Audit Log
prd.overview: The Audit Log is the cross-incident chain view. Operators filter by incident / event-type / actor / band / reporter-badge / date range; every filter change emits a ChainRead event per PRD §11.1. Anomaly surfacing propagates from any incident in the filter set. Drill-into per-incident segment via "Open chain segment" link to WO-003. This is the load-bearing surface for Goal 2.3 (100% of chain reads logged) and Goal 2.1 (chain verifiable).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/AuditLog.tsx (582 LOC); filter chips with URL persistence; emit ChainRead on filter change; cross-incident grouping

requirement.title: Mount route at /audit-log for utility_operator
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for utility_operator.

acceptance.criterion: Route renders for utility_operator
Non-operator roles redirect

requirement.title: Six filter chips (incident, event-type, actor, band, reporter-badge, date range)
requirement.description: Render six filter chips: incident (search input), event-type (multi-select), actor (search input), band (multi-select T1/T2/T3/resolved), reporter-badge (multi-select), date range picker.

acceptance.criterion: All six chips render with correct primitives
Each chip is interactive (verified by click/keyboard)

requirement.title: Filter chip URL persistence
requirement.description: Filter chip state serialises to URL query string (e.g., ?band=T1,T2&reporter=hotline). Loading URL params pre-populates chip state. Round-trips correctly.

acceptance.criterion: Setting chip updates URL
Loading URL populates chip state
Round-trip serialisation preserves all chip values

requirement.title: Filter change emits ChainRead event
requirement.description: Every filter change emits POST /api/events with ChainRead{actor, incident_id: null, filter_combo: [serialised chip values]}. Per PRD §11.1, 100% of chain reads must be logged.

acceptance.criterion: Filter change emits ChainRead with correct payload
filter_combo array contains all active chip values

requirement.title: Cross-incident grouping by incident_id
requirement.description: Render chain events grouped by incident_id. Each group has a header with incident ID + reporter-badge + band. Rows under each group sorted chronologically (ascending).

acceptance.criterion: Events grouped by incident_id
Within group, rows sorted chronologically ascending

requirement.title: Row composition (timestamp + actor + event-type icon + band + reporter + hash)
requirement.description: Each row renders: timestamp (relative + absolute on hover), actor chip, event-type icon (27 approved Lucide), band pill, reporter-badge chip, hash anchor (copy-to-clipboard).

acceptance.criterion: All row elements render in order
Event-type icon from 27 approved Lucide list
Hash anchor copy-to-clipboard works

requirement.title: Anomaly surfacing (row ⚠️ + top banner)
requirement.description: Row ⚠️ when recomputed hash != stored hash for any block. Persistent top banner: Chain anomaly in filter set — acknowledge or escalate. Banner has aria-live=polite and persists until acknowledged.

acceptance.criterion: Anomaly row renders ⚠️ icon
Top banner shows escalation prompt
Banner has aria-live=polite attribute

requirement.title: Open chain segment link → WO-003 page
requirement.description: Each row renders "Open chain segment" link → /incidents/:incident_id/chain (WO-003 dedicated page). Click navigates and ChainRead fires on that page mount.

acceptance.criterion: Link target correct (/incidents/:id/chain)
Click navigates; target page mounts and fires ChainRead

requirement.title: Date range picker uses DateRangePicker primitive
requirement.description: Date range filter uses DateRangePicker primitive from web/src/components/ui/. Not raw <input type="date">. Per lockdown decision #4.

acceptance.criterion: DateRangePicker primitive used (no raw date inputs in DOM)

requirement.title: Inline single-block verify reuses chain-verify helper
requirement.description: Inline verify button per row calls verifyBlock() from web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts. Never copy-pasted. Per lockdown §7 audit gap.

acceptance.criterion: verifyBlock call goes through helper (verified by import trace)
Helper never throws (network failure returns VerifyState.fail)

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: audit-log-page, …-header, …-main, …-filter-chips, …-chip-incident, …-chip-event-type, …-chip-actor, …-chip-band, …-chip-reporter-badge, …-chip-date-range, …-event-list, …-event-row, …-event-timestamp, …-actor-chip, …-event-type-icon, …-band-pill, …-reporter-badge-chip, …-hash-anchor, …-button-open-chain-segment, …-button-verify-inline, …-anomaly-banner.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for page title/subtitle, filter chip labels, button labels, anomaly banner, timestamp relative strings. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

acceptance.criterion: EN + BN key sets match
No Hindi keys present

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm helper reuse + URL persistence
requirement.description: Verify chain-verify.ts helper reused (no copy-paste); verify URL persistence round-trips; verify ChainRead emitted on every filter change (not just initial load).

acceptance.criterion: grep 'verifyBlock' import trace shows helper import
URL round-trip test passes
Filter change debounce/emission test passes (one event per change, not per chip toggle)

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Set chip values; assert URL query string. Reload; assert chips populated from URL. URL persistence round-trips.
Toggle a filter chip; intercept POST /api/events; assert ChainRead with filter_combo array. ChainRead emitted correctly.
Use anomaly fixture; mount; assert row ⚠️ + banner with aria-live=polite. Anomaly UI renders.
Click inline verify on row; assert helper import; force network failure; assert VerifyState.fail. Helper reused; never throws.
